title: App submissions open to SPORE users
summary:
SPORE users can submit apps, three community projects joined the catalog, and recent contributors got their names in the README.

Registered SPORE users can now submit apps alongside higher tiers. App review also preserves fuller descriptions, punctuation, accents, and submitted app names; Discord news links are more carefully matched to app submissions.

@samucamg’s VeroClass AI Teacher Hub helps Brazilian teachers plan lessons and track progress; @roni72640’s Metadatagenerator makes microstock metadata and prompts; and @rrs1979’s TelegramChannelAI automates channel content. The Greenhouse count reached 1,136 apps.

The README’s Latest News and Recent Apps sections were refreshed, with contributor names replacing generic attribution for recent additions.

daily.title: SPORE users can submit apps
daily.text: Registered SPORE users can submit their apps for the community catalog, alongside users on other tiers.
